setup.intro: Your group has been dropped into a strange new world together. Nobody read the instructions, and something is already going wrong.

roles.title: The Unofficial Leader
roles.blurb: Nobody picked them. They picked themselves.

roles.title: The Wildcard
roles.blurb: Nobody can predict them, including them.

roles.title: The Voice of Reason
roles.blurb: Ignored in every crisis so far.

roles.title: The Snack Keeper
roles.blurb: Controls the supplies, and therefore the group.

roles.title: The Hype Person
roles.blurb: Believes in the group more than the group does.

relationships: {a} owes {b} a favour, and {b} brings it up a lot.
{a} and {b} have a running inside joke nobody else understands.

secret.title: Something's missing
secret.scene: Your group has one night before the big event everyone came here for. Things are already going wrong, and each of you knows something the others don't.

briefs.secret: You checked the budget. The group has enough money for tonight, but not for tomorrow.
briefs.prompt: What do you do with this?

options.outcome: {name} announced the money problem. Tonight's plans got a lot cheaper.
{name} quietly cancelled the fancy dinner reservation. Nobody knows why yet.

options.text: Keep some money aside for yourself
options.outcome: {name} has a secret emergency fund. Just for {name}.

briefs.secret: You heard about a shortcut that saves a whole day, but it goes somewhere you've been told never to go.

options.outcome: {name} took the shortcut and came back with a story they won't fully tell.
{name} took {someone} down the shortcut. They made it, and now they share a secret.
{name} ignored the shortcut. Safe, and slightly bored.

briefs.secret: There's only one comfortable bed left, and two people are exhausted.
briefs.outcome: {name} gave the good bed to {choice}. Somebody else slept on a pile of coats.

briefs.secret: The one thing everyone needs for tomorrow is broken. You can fix it tonight, but only by using someone else's stuff.

options.outcome: {name} fixed it using {someone}'s belongings. {someone} hasn't noticed yet.
{name} pulled an all-nighter and built something held together with tape and hope.
{name} left it broken. Tomorrow-{name} will deal with it.

briefs.secret: A stranger offered you a big favour, if you vouch for them to the group.

options.outcome: {name} vouched for the stranger. The group has a new, very smiley member.
{name} took the favour and never vouched. The stranger is furious.
{name} told the group about the stranger, who has now vanished.

briefs.secret: You accidentally broke something that belongs to {someone}. Nobody saw.

options.outcome: {name} confessed to breaking {someone}'s thing. It was awkward, but honest.
{name} hid the evidence. {someone} is still looking for it.
{name} blamed the stranger. It was very convincing.

secret.title: The offer
secret.scene: Morning. Someone important has shown up with an offer that could change everything for the group. Before the meeting, you each get a moment alone.

briefs.secret: You overheard the visitor say the offer is only for one person, not the whole group.

options.outcome: {name} told everyone the offer was for one person. The room got very tense.
{name} pulled the visitor aside and pitched themselves. Hard.
{name} recommended {someone} for the offer. {someone} has no idea.

briefs.secret: You read the fine print. The offer comes with a catch nobody else has noticed.

options.outcome: {name} found the catch, and the visitor looked very uncomfortable.
{name} said nothing about the catch. Somebody is going to find out the hard way.

briefs.secret: The visitor wants an answer by lunch. Somebody has to decide, and everyone is looking at you.

options.outcome: {name} said yes on everyone's behalf. Bold.
{name} turned the offer down. The visitor left looking insulted.
{name} stalled so well the visitor forgot what they were offering.

briefs.secret: One person in the group is clearly struggling and hasn't told anyone.
briefs.outcome: {name} checked on {choice}, who was either very touched or very confused.

briefs.secret: You could sneak a look at the visitor's bag while they're distracted.

options.outcome: {name} looked in the bag and found something they can't stop thinking about.
{name} left the bag alone. Unusually restrained.

briefs.secret: You have a feeling you've met the visitor before, but you can't remember where.

options.text: Ask them in front of everyone
options.outcome: {name} asked the visitor where they'd met in front of everyone. Deeply awkward.
{name} greeted the visitor like an old friend. The visitor played along.
{name} and {someone} are now investigating the visitor together.

secret.title: The final night
secret.scene: It's the last night. Everything the group did so far is catching up with you, and there's one last chance to get things right. Each of you holds one piece of the ending.

briefs.secret: Someone has to stay behind and finish the job while everyone else celebrates.
briefs.outcome: {name} decided {choice} would stay behind. {choice} will be bringing this up for years.

briefs.secret: You have a backup plan nobody knows about, but it only works for some of the group.

options.outcome: {name} shared the backup plan. It half-worked, which is better than usual.
{name} kept their backup plan secret. Just in case.

briefs.secret: There's one last thank-you gift to hand out.
briefs.outcome: {name} gave the last gift to {choice}. Everyone else has opinions.

briefs.secret: You could end the night with one huge, reckless gesture.

options.outcome: {name} went big. Nobody will ever forget it, for better or worse.
{name} played it safe for once. The group is still in shock.

briefs.secret: You get to give the final speech. You could say something nice or tell the truth about someone.

options.outcome: {name} gave a heartfelt speech. Two people cried.
{name} roasted {someone} in the final speech. It was brutal and hilarious.
{name} revealed a secret in the speech. The room went silent.

briefs.secret: You could leave without saying goodbye, and it would be very mysterious.

options.outcome: {name} vanished before the end. There is a note, and it's confusing.
{name} stayed and hugged everyone. Twice.

choice.scene: A mysterious door appears. A sign on it says 'ONE PERSON ONLY.'
options: Walk away and never speak of it

choice.scene: The group's supplies have mysteriously halved overnight.
A stranger offers the group a deal that sounds too good to be true.
options: Let {someone} decide and blame them later

vote_player.scene: Someone has been keeping a secret diary about the group.
vote_player.prompt: Who is writing the secret diary?

vote_player.scene: The group needs a spokesperson to negotiate with the locals.
vote_player.prompt: Who would make the negotiation go spectacularly wrong?

vote_player.scene: One person has been awarded a medal for 'services to the group.'
vote_player.prompt: Who would give the longest acceptance speech?

predict.scene: {target} finds a bag of gold coins nobody else has seen.
{target} is offered the chance to go home early, alone.
{target} gets one wish, but everyone will know what it was.

recap.epilogue: The adventure is over. The stories are just getting started.
